key_insight: The paper shows how to generate graphs whose persistent homology matches a target persistence diagram exactly, rather than only approximately.
engineering_relevance: This enables topology-constrained graph synthesis for design and simulation pipelines where exact structural guarantees matter.
method: Local iterative generation of degree-based PD-equivalent graphs with provable exactness and reachability.
Global formulation as a complete constraint satisfaction problem solved by modern CP solvers.
Applies to any vertex-based permutation-equivariant filtration and is minimal under degree filtration.
evidence_signal: Across four standard graph generation benchmarks, both proposed methods produced graphs whose target persistence diagrams were matched exactly.
watch_item: The local method can trade off diversity and may encounter infeasible states, so solver-based global encoding may be preferable but could be more computationally demanding.
paper_title: Exact Topological Compliance: Generating Persistence-Equivalent Graphs
